Confidential
Why Use Python?
● Quick iteration
● No compile times!
● Vast wealth of 3rd party libraries
● Easy to distribute
● Don’t need to involve programmers
● Easier to learn
● Can extend Python based workflow from Maya to engine
● I like Python :)

Confidential
Python in Unreal Engine

Confidential
Python in Unreal Engine
● Unreal Python
○ Official Epic implementation
○ Released in UE 4.19
○ Python 2.7 integrated, supports building with custom versions
● UnrealEnginePython
○ 3rd Party Plugin
○ Available on Github:  github.com/20tab/UnrealEnginePython
○ Full access to UE4 Reflection system
○ Python 2.7, 3.5 & 3.6 supported
Unreal Python wasn’t available at the start of our project :(

Confidential
UnrealEnginePython
● Embedded Python VM
● Built in Python console
● Access to UE4 internal API & 
Reflection system
● Ability to extend editor

Case Study #1: Asset Ingestion

Confidential
The Problem
“Import & setup many props in as little time as possible with as little 
human error as possible.”
● Be able to support small art team (6 artists, 2 full time on props)
● Cope with the large asset throughput with minimal error & repetition
● Heavy reliance on outsourcing
○ Rapid turnaround on fixes & new content
○ Easy to use authoring workflow
● Retain a consistent art style across a variety of themes
● Keep User Generated Content in mind!
